title: Scalar extension of a specified finite presentation with normalized quotient generators
statement: Let R and T be commutative rings in the same universe, f:R→T a ring homomorphism, and N an R-module with a specified right-exact presentation R^m --D--> R^n --q--> N → 0, with m,n finite [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. There are a T-linear map p:T^n→T⊗_R N and an isomorphism v:T⊗_R N≅coker(D mapped by f), such that p(f(x_i))=1⊗q(x) for every x∈R^n and p followed by v is the specified categorical cokernel projection. No injectivity or flatness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), finite-presentation calculation; Stacks, algebra.tex lemma-tensor-product-exact; sites-modules.tex section-constant and section-tensor-product.

proof.text: Identify N with coker D using exactness and surjectivity.

Use the ordinary extension/restriction scalar adjunction to preserve the cokernel. The tensor finite-power isomorphism sends 1 tensor x to (f(x_i)); conjugation identifies the extended matrix with D mapped by f.
Compose the preserved cokernel and matrix isomorphisms and verify the projection equation by functoriality. The inverse finite-power comparison gives the original-vector normalization.

mathlib_searches.query: A constant sheaf module realization followed by scalar extension preserves a matrix cokernel and its quotient projection, and an invertible change of rows identifies the cokernel with the remaining coordinates
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.cokernelIsoRangeQuotient, ModuleCat.cokernelIsColimit, Module.Presentation.ofExact, SheafOfModules.presentationOfIsCokernelFree and related generic presentation infrastructure. No complete normalized finite-power scalar and row-operation comparison. Used categorical cokernel infrastructure.

Found ModuleCat.isColimitCokernelCofork and PreservesCokernel.iso with its projection equation. These are used to construct the normalized comparisons; neither supplies the coefficientwise finite-power normalization or the rank-tail computation.

Read Mathlib ModuleCat/Kernels, ChangeOfRings, TensorProduct/Pi, Matrix/ToLin, Limits/Preserves/Shapes/Kernels. Project search found the parent presentationModels hole, ScalarNormalizedConstantModels (different internal-module encoding), and IntegralScalarModelCoordinates (different discrete-model setting). No duplicate of these normalized helpers.
